travelTipItems.title: Arrive 20 minutes early
travelTipItems.body: Buy your ticket at the counter and keep a little buffer for queues, snacks, and finding the platform.

travelTipItems.title: Keep small cash ready
travelTipItems.body: Bus fares and local rides are easiest with Thai baht notes. Keep coins or small bills for songthaews in Pattaya.

travelTipItems.title: Plan around Bangkok traffic
travelTipItems.body: Morning and evening departures can take longer. Add extra time if you connect to a flight or train.

faqItems.question: How long is the bus from Bangkok to Pattaya?
faqItems.answer: The bus usually takes around 2-3 hours, depending on traffic and the departure station.

faqItems.question: Where do I buy tickets?
faqItems.answer: You can usually buy tickets at the bus station counter. Some routes may also be available online. Confirm before travel.

faqItems.question: Can I take a bus from Suvarnabhumi Airport?
faqItems.answer: Yes, there are bus services between Suvarnabhumi Airport and Pattaya. Check the current schedule before you go.

faqItems.question: Do buses run every day?
faqItems.answer: Most routes run daily, but departure times may change on holidays or busy travel days.
